messages:
Priya S: bumping this thread 3: PR open to add nn-int8 migration guidance for Dedicated & Private: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/435
Ethan V: nice. what's the scope? configs, runtime notes, and snippets?
Priya S: yes 3 main parts: migration checklist, example runtime flags for dedicated nodes, SDK v3 snippet differences (embeddings.create vs embeddings.generate), a short note about sequence ceiling differences for aurora-xl variants, and fix a stale link to bench results CSV
Carla M: small reminder 3 we recently changed the SDK method names in v3.0.0-rc; docs must show both older and newer forms with a clear heading so customers following older docs aren't confused
Priya S: added a small table in the PR describing method name mapping and a note: "If you upgraded to SDK v3+, prefer .generate for both embeddings and text generation. .create is deprecated."
Ethan V: can you paste the SDK snippet for embeddings v3? some users reported truncated long docs when they used generate without truncate param
Priya S: snippet in PR description:
```python
# SDK v3+: embeddings with explicit truncation behavior
resp = client.embeddings.generate(model="aurora-xl", input=["very long doc..."], truncate=True)
# legacy SDK v2.x example (for migration reference)
resp_v2 = client.embeddings.create(model="aurora-xl", input=["very long doc..."])
```
Carla M: nit: mention that truncate=True will silently drop tokens beyond model context; add a link to guidance on chunking in the migration checklist
Priya S: done 3 added link to chunking guidance and a short recommend chunk size equation: min( model_context - 256, 8192 ) for overlap-friendly sliding windows
docs-bot: docs CI linkcheck flagged: broken link to benchmarks CSV in the Benchmarks section :x: https://ci.redwood.ai/links/435
Priya S: I fixed the CSV URL and pushed a tiny change to wording in Benchmarks
Ethan V: runtime requirement for nn-int8? we need a clear minimum runtime + CUDA version for Dedicated and Private
Priya S: added "Requires runtime >= v1.8.2 and CUDA >= 11.8 for nn-int8 on Dedicated; Private deployments must include the nn-int8 kernel bundle."
Carla M: suggest phrasing: "nn-int8 requires runtime >= v1.8.2" instead of starts-with verboseness
Priya S: updated phrasing to match style guide
bench-bot: uploaded new CSV and bench dashboard entry: https://bench.redwood.ai/2026/aurora-xl-nnint8
infra-bot: note: CI will now run a flavor-detection check for PRs touching model-catalog runtime requirements (follow-up issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/98)
Ethan V: QA ask: can we add a tiny table in the model card showing both "declared_max_sequence" and "effective_max_sequence" for quant and fp variants so customers know the runtime-enforced limit?
Priya S: added the table and short footnote about per-batch limits vs per-request ceilings
Carla M: I eyeballed mobile rendering on preview; anchor IDs were slightly off for the "Benchmarks" deep link, pushed anchor fix
Priya S: rebased and squashed, docs CI passed :white_check_mark: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/435
Carla M: LGTM after the anchor + CI green; anyone object to merge?
Ethan V: LGTM from infra perspective
docs-bot: merged PR #435 and kicked off docs preview deploy https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/model-catalog/aurora-xl-migration
Priya S: preview looks good. leaving a follow-up to auto-generate the compat matrix from bench metadata so we stop hand-editing it: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/issues/220
Carla M: filing a tiny follow-up to add an SDK snippet test in docs CI to catch generate/create mismatches
Priya S: thanks all, closing thread :tada:
